purpose: sunset-rmx.15 real local smoke: public run -> attributed DSC -> inspect on the approved difficult-page stage (engineering-only). Companion record: fixtures/digitization/local-smoke.org.
executor: agent-executed (recorded deviation; a human pass supersedes)

engine_stack.note: references.org proposed pdftoppm for rendering; the shipped pipeline pins PyMuPDF for both recorded and local routes (recorded deviation, reuse decision in docs/src/digitization.org). Poppler pdftoppm 26.01.0 is installed but unused by this route.

baseline.dsc_validation: descriptor.json passed dsc03.validator.validate inside the run (finish refuses invalid exports)

regional.dsc_validation: descriptor.json passed dsc03.validator.validate inside the run (finish refuses invalid exports)

incidents.what: first regional dispatch refused: attempt-limit-exceeded (initially pinned max_provider_attempts=2, sized for the whole-page era)
incidents.resolution: stage re-pinned to max_provider_attempts=160 (detector measured 65+56=121 crops on pages [2,5]) BEFORE any regional recognition completed; baseline re-run bound to the final configs so both recorded runs share the shipped stage manifest
incidents.residue: budget refusal discards the stage directory including the durable ledger (completed attempts are lost on refusal). Candidate hardening ticket filed; refusal itself is pre-I/O so no dispatch-uncertainty exists.

incidents.what: real smoke surfaced KeyError('pages') in digitization.structure.collect for local configs, which deliberately carry no recorded per-page observations
incidents.resolution: TDD red->green: tests/tracer/test_digitization_local_route.py::test_shipped_stage_config_has_no_pages_key (both routes), fix digitization/structure.py collect() reads config.get('pages', {})

incidents.what: python -m digitization replay --run <local-mode run> exits 4 (unsupported-version): digitization/replay.py requires manifest mode 'recorded'
incidents.resolution: out of rmx.15 scope; zero-inference replay of local-mode runs is required by sunset-rmx.11 acceptance and noted in that ticket

reproducibility: Run directories keep their heavy derivable blobs (renders/crops/source copy) local-only (gitignored); all JSON/text records and budget ledgers are tracked. Re-running the recorded argv on the pinned stack reproduces the artifacts byte-for-byte (pymupdf render + tesseract crop OCR are deterministic for the pinned versions); digests above verify.
claims: Smoke proves wiring only. Engineering-only stage: no reference, all six quality scopes evaluation-incomplete, no quality/economy/scaling conclusion claimable; negative/rejection decisions remain possible.
